Class MavenSearchRequest

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.nb.tools.maven.MavenSearchRequest
public class MavenSearchRequest extends Object
Encapsulates search parameters for unified Maven repository index querying.

Supports both unstructured keyword queries (which are automatically split and joined with AND semantics) and fully structured MavenQueryClause boolean query trees. Also provides sorting, version collapsing, and stable-only filtering options.

anahata
